title: Repository is NBA-focused and has multiple NFL specification dashboards
detail: The brief says NFL lines; the inherited repo is largely NBA research. Prior sessions published nfl/**, nfl-research/**, nfl-lab/**, nfl-quant/** and nfl-study/** claims. This session uses the unclaimed nfl-origin/** namespace.

title: COORDINATION.md contains literal merge-conflict markers
detail: Lines inherited from earlier sessions contain unresolved <<<<<<< / ======= / >>>>>>> markers. They are preserved verbatim and flagged, not silently edited.

title: README.md contains unresolved merge-conflict markers
detail: The inherited root README includes an unresolved conflict section and describes NBA research. It is outside this session's scope and is not edited.

title: No official NFL betting-line or price archive
detail: NFL.com publishes schedules, standings, stats and integrity policy but no official odds/closing-line archive. All market-price cells are blank.

title: Week 9 injury report not yet published
detail: The official injuries portal still showed week 8 at retrieval. No injury adjustment is applied to upcoming lines.

title: Listed home team may not be true home team at neutral sites
detail: Official game URLs use an 'away-at-home' listing order. ESPN partner JSON neutralSite flags are used only as a cross-check; no home-field advantage is applied where the partner marks a game neutral.

title: Official schedule body hides scores but game links expose them
detail: Week-18 and some scoreboard tiles show 'Hidden Score' in the rendered body; the accessible official game-link text contains the final score. Parsed rows use the official link text.

title: Kickoff ISO timestamps are partner-sourced
detail: NFL.com link text gives weekday/month/day but not a full ISO timestamp; ESPN partner JSON supplies kickoff UTC for rest calculations. It is labelled partner-sourced, not an NFL publication.

title: Player stats table does not publish team affiliation
detail: NFL.com player category tables list player and aggregate values but no team column; team cells are blank.

title: No funded leaderboard reward pool is defined by an official source
detail: The brief describes a leaderboard competition with rewards, but no official NFL or repository source defines a prize pool or reward points. Reward fields are blank.

title: Derived model outputs are not official NFL publications
detail: Elo ratings, fair lines, correlations, Brier scores and leaderboard scores are reproducible computations from official inputs; they are not published NFL values.

title: 2026 out-of-sample holdout is below 300 games
detail: Only 120 2026 regular-season games were final at retrieval; the pre-registered G1 gate requires at least 300 holdout observations.

title: Root navigation does not link nfl-origin/
detail: Root index.html already links the earlier nfl/ module. A root link to this section is logged as a shared-output request rather than editing another session's navigation.

title: 2025 ESPN calendar file mixes seasons
detail: The ESPN dates=2025 response includes 2024 week 18 and 2024 postseason events; parsing filters on season.year and season.type==2.

title: Official standings heading contains template placeholders
detail: The 2026 NFL.com standings page renders '$year$ NFL $displayname$ Standings' in its heading. The table values are used; the heading artifact is not.

title: One week-8 game was still scheduled at retrieval
detail: Chicago at Seattle (2026 week 8) had not kicked off; it is excluded from completed-game verification and included in the upcoming own-line slate.

title: Player-level game logs and prop prices are unavailable from official sources
detail: Official NFL.com publishes season player tables, not a downloadable official game-log/prop-price archive. Player-prop combo correlations remain blank.
